{"full_source_conversation":"seeker: I feel heavy pressures from my parents, they also want me to be the top of the class but I find it tough because they are other top students
seeker: Please what do I do?
supporter: Hi! how are you doing today?
seeker: Not so good, I'm feeling down
supporter: It sounds like you have low energy. What makes you feel down?
seeker: My parents keep putting pressures on me to be the best in the class and with my learning difficulties I am finding it had to cope 
supporter: I can understand parental pressure. They want to see you to be a successful person. Sometime it is overwhelming. you should talk to them that you are doing your best.
seeker: I have tried, I am even doing extra classes but they still keep on putting pressure on me. On top of that all my friends have distant from me for no reason and they ganged up on me to bully me 
supporter: It must be tough time for you. show your work report to your parents and try to tell them all the people are born with different potential.
seeker: Hmm...That doesn't seem like a bad idea. I am just worry that my parents will not be very understanding. My parents are too strict and they don't like to hear any complaints or excuses.
supporter: Most of the parents behave like this when it is regarding their kids future. When I was in school same thing happened with mw. They know us very well I realized now.  Try to talk to them everyday for a while. It might work.
seeker: Maybe you're right! Although, my parents have a very busy schedule but fingers crossed when I do find time to talk to them they will understand me. 
seeker: I sometimes feel like someone older needs to talk to them, maybe then my parents may take it more seriously
seeker: Well! Thanks I give what you said a go
supporter: Hope you are feeling bit relaxed now. 
seeker: Yes! I feel a lot better now that I know someone understands how I feel 
supporter: I am glad that I am able to make you happy. 
seeker: One more thing
seeker: How should I respond to the friends that are ganging up on me?
supporter: sure! You don't have to worry about that. that should be their problem. just ignore them or don't give attention. They will stop doing it for sure.
seeker: Hmm..interesting because now that I think about it, I believe this could have contributed to the stress and anxieties that I have been experiencing. When I don't get support from anyone I feel so alone, timid and down 
supporter: Try to take small break while studying and try to relax 
seeker: Yes, I find that has helped me a bit also because I have quite a short attention span . Also, I am currently on the path of trying to find more unique techniques to help revision more fun and exciting for me 
supporter: That's great! you will do awesome.
seeker: Thank you very much! I feel much better now and I've taken on board what you said, hopefully there will be a positive change in my parents character. :)
supporter: You are welcome!
seeker: Alright! Well I'll talk to you some other time to give an update 
supporter: Sure! take care
seeker: Thanks you too! :)","kind":"MS","reported_at":"2024-07-10","schema":"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2","speaker_scope":"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography."}

{"full_source_conversation":"seeker: Hello
seeker: Please reply to me 
supporter: hi how are you
seeker: I am not good . 
seeker: What about you?
supporter: i am so sorry to hear that. what seems to be worrying you today?
supporter: i am doing ok thanks for asking
seeker: I trust my friends blindly. But they not. 
seeker: It creates depression on my mind
seeker: I cannot concentrate on any other works
supporter: it seems to me that you feel you can not trust a friend, correct me if im wrong?
seeker: I trust my friends very much. They won't show the same trustfulness on me.  
supporter: Oh ok, have you asked them why they feel they can not trust you?
supporter: Maybe you could have a conversation about it and see what you could do to gain their trust.
supporter: I have had a friend not to trust me and i know how hurtful that can feel, maybe there has just been some sort of misunderstanding.
seeker: They think I am not suitable for some places. They want to go that places without my knowledge is not a problem. But they hide the total matter
seeker: It may be misunderstanding. I tried to talk with them.
seeker: They won't respond to me
supporter: Could it be that it is not that they do not trust you but they feel you would not feel comfortable going to such places?
seeker: If they feel uncomfortable , they could speak directly but they won't did that also
supporter: I am sorry you feel ignored sometimes people choose to ignore issues rather than confront them and try to come to some sort of solution, i would try not to take it to personnel as you seem like a very friendly person. 
supporter: You could try to send a message just stating that your feelings are hurt and it would be nice if they would at least reply back with a explanation on why they have made you feel this way.
seeker: Can you any idea to get out from this?
supporter: Are you asking how to end the chat?
seeker: no
seeker: how to get out from my depression?
supporter: I think you need to spend some time doing something you enjoy to try to take your mind off of it, maybe go to a movie or for a nice walk.
supporter: Or if you have a family member you are close to you could speak to them about it and see what the perspective of the situation is.
seeker: Thank you my dear. 
seeker: I got a little bit idea
seeker: I will try to explore it
seeker: is there any general way to get out from stress?
supporter: No problem you really seem like a nice person so i think the problem more so is with them and not you so try not to let it ruin your holiday season!
supporter: When i am stressed or depressed I like to workout and listen to music.
seeker: I like to read book. Shall I try this?
supporter: Yes getting lost in a good book is a great way to get your mind off of it!
seeker: Thank you friend. Shall we end the chat?
supporter: If you feel i have helped you we can, if not i am glad to stay and continue trying to help.
seeker: I feel very happy about your help
supporter: i am glad i could be of some help i hope you feel better soon!
seeker: Ok buddy. Thank you and bye. 
supporter: you are very welcome, goodbye","kind":"MS","reported_at":"2024-09-05","schema":"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2","speaker_scope":"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography."}
